title: Responsible Fintech Institute and Safeheron Launch Cross-Regional Post-Quantum Digital Asset Pilot - Quantum Computing Report
gist: The Responsible Fintech Institute and Safeheron have launched a cross-border pilot that embeds the NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 lattice signature standard directly into a non-custodial 2-of-2 MPC wallet protocol, tested on NEAR testnet with ADGM, GFSO and MFSA regulators as Phase 1 observers. It marks the point where post-quantum migration in digital assets moves from advisory papers to live transaction signing under supervisory scrutiny.

insights.claim: Safeheron has built a multi-party computation protocol that natively integrates ML-DSA-65, the module-lattice digital signature algorithm standardized in NIST FIPS 204, rather than layering post-quantum signatures on top of an existing classical scheme.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Native PQC-in-MPC is the hard engineering problem in custody; a working implementation is a durable moat versus custody vendors still on ECDSA-only threshold schemes.
insights.quote: a multi-party computation (MPC) protocol that natively integrates ML-DSA-65—the module-lattice digital signature standard published in NIST FIPS 204

insights.claim: The pilot uses a non-custodial 2-of-2 MPC architecture so participating financial institutions retain ownership of a key share while testing distributed signing without single points of failure.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: The 2-of-2 non-custodial split is the structure banks need to hold digital assets without taking third-party custody risk; it is the template regulated custody products will copy.
insights.quote: a non-custodial 2-of-2 MPC architecture, allowing financial institutions to maintain key share ownership

insights.claim: The pilot's architecture pairs the post-quantum signing stack with NEAR testnet integration, meaning the PQC transaction flows are being exercised against a live public-blockchain environment rather than a purely simulated ledger.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Chain-level PQC testing surfaces the real bottleneck — larger lattice signature sizes and fees on-chain — which is where migration economics will be decided.

insights.claim: Safeheron plans to open-source the underlying PQC-MPC protocol code to enable independent security audits, and the consortium will publish a whitepaper covering protocol design, cross-border interoperability metrics, and operational resilience findings.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Open-sourcing shifts Safeheron's value capture from protocol secrecy to standard-setting and service revenue, and accelerates the whole custody sector's migration timeline.
insights.quote: plans to open-source the underlying PQC-MPC protocol code to enable independent security audits

insights.claim: Financial regulators participate as observers in Phase 1 of the pilot before joining a dedicated governance workstream in Phase 2 that assesses supervisory expectations, cross-border compliance, and operational risks.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A staged observe-then-govern structure means supervisory rules for post-quantum custody are being drafted from this pilot's data; early participants shape the rulebook they will later be judged by.
insights.quote: Financial regulators participate as observers in Phase 1 before contributing to a dedicated governance workstream in Phase 2

insights.claim: The pilot is explicitly aligned with supervisory frameworks in Asia and Europe including the Monetary Authority of Singapore’s technology risk directives, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority’s Fintech 2030 Quantum Preparedness Index, and the Malta Financial Services Authority’s ICT risk monitoring.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: HKMA's named Quantum Preparedness Index implies scored supervisory assessment of banks' crypto-agility — a compliance deadline forming that will pull forward PQC vendor spend.
insights.quote: the Hong Kong Monetary Authority’s (HKMA) Fintech 2030 Quantum Preparedness Index

insights.claim: The pilot's regulatory observer set spans ADGM, GFSO and MFSA, giving the trial a Gulf-Europe supervisory footprint rather than a single-jurisdiction sandbox.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Cross-jurisdiction observation is what makes a sandbox result portable; results here are more likely to be recognized across regimes than a single-regulator trial.

insights.claim: The pilot is framed as a response to regulatory directives from central banks and supervisory authorities that urge financial institutions to establish cryptographic agility and migration frameworks, making PQC readiness a compliance obligation rather than a discretionary security upgrade.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Compliance-driven demand is price-insensitive and calendar-bound; it is the strongest near-term revenue driver for PQC and crypto-agility vendors.
insights.quote: urging financial institutions to establish cryptographic agility and migration frameworks

insights.claim: The consortium is led by RFI Chairman Chia Hock Lai, Safeheron Chief Security & Policy Officer Jag Foo, Bison Bank CEO António Henriques, and GFSO Managing Director David Peters, pairing a licensed bank with a custody-tech vendor and a standards body.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Direct participation of a licensed bank CEO signals the pilot targets regulated balance-sheet custody, not crypto-native users — the larger and slower-moving addressable market.
insights.locator: Led by RFI Chairman Chia Hock Lai

insights.claim: The initiative convenes international commercial banks and financial regulators across multiple jurisdictions to test post-quantum wallet generation and transaction signing in a controlled environment, targeting the two operations most exposed to a future cryptographically relevant quantum computer.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Wallet generation and signing are the migration chokepoints for digital assets; whoever standardizes them captures the integration layer for institutional crypto custody.
insights.quote: test post-quantum wallet generation and transaction signing in a controlled environment
insights.locator: The Responsible Fintech Institute (RFI) and digital asset security provider Safeheron
